card.name: Last word of a fixed idiom
card.fires_on: The final word of a set English phrase, such as 'to do' in 'little to do with', 'miss' in 'hit-or-miss', 'down' in 'upside down', or '-hand' in 'first-hand'. It fires on the word where the idiom is complete or nearly complete.

modes.label: to do with
modes.description: The word 'do' in 'nothing/less/little to do with'.
modes.example: Fighting malaria, he said, had very little to<< do>> with the intricacies of science and biology

modes.label: Compound idioms
modes.description: The closing part of a hyphenated or fixed phrase like hit-or-miss, first-hand, upside down.
modes.example: these applications can be hit-or-m<<iss>>. Pew researchers have found many parents

modes.label: Other set phrases
modes.description: The last word of phrases like 'on earth' or 'of a lifetime'.
modes.example: How on<< earth>> does he accomplish this?

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese words and rare fragments, so there is no clear link to the text pattern.
card.plain: It lights up on the last word of a stock phrase like 'nothing to do with' or 'hit-or-miss'.
